snippet.title: Quartermark - Official Trailer | 440 Monsters, 100 Bosses
snippet.description:
This RPG plays itself. Four heroes fight on their own across 100 maps, 3,400 floors and 440 monsters. You decide who fights and what they carry.
⚔️ Wishlist on Steam and play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5061040/Quartermark/

🛡️ There is no attack button. You build the party, pick the gear and choose the skills, and the fight runs itself
🧙 12 heroes, and every one speaks the same four-skill language: Basic, Core, Reaction and Aura
👹 440 unique 3D monsters, each with its own animations
🗺️ 100 maps, 100 bosses and 3,400 floors, with real light and weather in every map
✨ 9 keywords shared by heroes and items, plus hero pairs that empower each other into gold-star combos
🎲 Upgrades are a gamble: each +1 raises every stat on the item, and a failed attempt destroys it
🔁 Prestige to go further. Your gear, souls and heroes stay with you
🏆 Steam leaderboards for deepest floor, prestiges and bosses

The free demo covers the first ten maps and their ten bosses with four heroes. Play it, then wishlist Quartermark so Steam lets you know when the full game is out. Subscribe to ACA Games for more.

More from ACA Games:
🐠 ARC Aquarium: a cozy aquarium where every fish is a card (free demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4213290/ARC_Aquarium/
🔺 Prismhold: a card-driven tower defense (Steam page coming soon)
